exposure: Period before (2000-2005) vs. after (2008-2014) the HYPITAT-I trial dissemination
Presence of gestational hypertension or pre-eclampsia (HDP group) vs. no HDP (reference group)
Hospital participation in HYPITAT-I vs. non-participation
cohort: The study included 143,749 women with gestational hypertension or pre-eclampsia and 1,649,510 pregnant women without these conditions, all with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation delivered between 36+0 and 40+6 weeks of gestation in The Netherlands from 2000-2014.
finding: Following the HYPITAT-I trial, there was a higher rate of induction of labor and improved obstetric outcomes, including decreased maternal and perinatal deaths, in term pregnancies complicated by hypertensive disorders of pregnancy in The Netherlands.
mod_finding: The rate of induction of labor increased significantly after the HYPITAT-I trial, and there was an increased incidence of emergency Cesarean section in both HDP and reference groups, with the increase being greater in the reference group.
